admission.justification: Per-harness packages and one common example were weighed; the choice forbids product writes into workspace dot folders from now on.

alternatives.option: Remove the nine packages; document the tool-server registration once as a common example that each harness adapts; the product writes no skills, hooks or AR files into dot folders at the workspace root and leaves existing folders alone.
alternatives.reason: Their main job, installing skills and hooks, is gone; the one remaining part, the tool-server registration, is a common example modern agents adapt.

alternatives.option: Keep a starter package per harness that installs skills, hooks and the tool-server registration into its harness root.
alternatives.reason: The packages duplicated what the served skills and the common example provide and drifted per harness.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A supported harness cannot be configured from the common example and needs a product-written file in its own folder.

consequences: .github and .githooks are not harness packages and stay.
Install pages lose their hook and skill copy steps and point to the common example.
context: The repository carried nine harness starter packages (.agents, .claude, .codex, .cursor, .github-vscode, .hermes, .openclaw, .pi, .vscode) whose job was to install skills, hooks and the tool-server registration into each harness root. The served packaged skills had replaced the skill copies.
decider: The developer (D690, D693 Q3); MIK-R84 v10 behaviour 6.
